newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU to hold special Luxembourg jobs summit.
newsitem.headline: EU to hold special Luxembourg jobs summit.

text.p: European Union leaders agreed on Monday to hold a special summit on jobs in October in Luxembourg, a French official said on Monday.

Presidential spokeswoman Catherine Colonna said it was agreed to restrict the meeting to a four-point agenda: employment in small and medium-size businesses; completion of the single European market; evaluating national experiences in employment and an initiative for the European Investment Bank to provide risk capital for high-tech ventures.
The date under discussion was October 17.
Colonna said some leaders had expressed misgivings about a separate summit on jobs, warning that it could raise expectations that would be hard to fulfil.
There was general agreement that the summit had to be well prepared and focused on a limited agenda, she said.
